from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u073/system/state/workspace/programs/task-f023d60d.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    candidates = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w - 2):
            cells = [(r, c+i) for i in range(3)]
            if all(grid[y][x] != bg for y, x in cells):
                candidates.append(cells)
    for r in range(h - 2):
        for c in range(w):
            cells = [(r+i, c) for i in range(3)]
            if all(grid[y][x] != bg for y, x in cells):
                candidates.append(cells)
    if not candidates:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The task template is a three-cell straight motif; retain its ordered colors.
    cells = candidates[0]
    colors = [grid[y][x] for y, x in cells]
    anchor = cells[1]
    excluded = set(cells)
    counts = Counter(v for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row)
                     if v != bg and (r,c) not in excluded)
    target = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    targets = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
               if grid[r][c] == target and (r,c) not in excluded]
    dr = cells[2][0] - cells[1][0]
    dc = cells[2][1] - cells[1][1]
    for r,c in targets:
        for k,color in zip((-1,0,1), colors):
            y, x = r + k*dr, c + k*dc
            if 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w:
                out[y][x] = color
    return out
'''
